title: Past the Lamp Net
who: captain of the crew on station at the lamp net
want: Carry a sealed case of lamp parts through the net to the keepers' tender while a hull holds a hull-length off.
at_stake: The parts miss the tender's schedule, the lamps starve, and your crew carries the blame for the delay.
complication: An unknown vessel holds observation geometry on the ship through the whole job. (complications.md, courier 2)

approaches.label: Fly the case in on a slow arc
Hail the watching hull and ask its business
Pass the case by a relay buoy
approaches.npc_reaction: does not like a lane logged twice

Fly the case in on a slow arc.clean: the keepers' tender pays your crew for parts delivered on schedule
Fly the case in on a slow arc.cost: the slow arc burns fuel your crew pays for
Fly the case in on a slow arc.fail: the watching hull cuts across the arc and your crew pays the tender for the missed schedule

Hail the watching hull and ask its busin.clean: the captain tells other crews yours kept its nerve under a watching hull
Hail the watching hull and ask its busin.cost: the hull answers but charges your crew a fee for the answer
Hail the watching hull and ask its busin.fail: the hull answers before your crew finishes asking and your crew pays the captain for a ruined approach

Pass the case by a relay buoy.clean: the tender pays your crew for a delivery the watching hull never saw
Pass the case by a relay buoy.cost: the buoy hand-off costs your crew a replacement buoy
Pass the case by a relay buoy.fail: the buoy fails and your crew pays for the case's recovery

sensory_details_used.light: a hull's steady running lights a hull-length off
sensory_details_used.sight: a grey chart that does not tell you where anything is
sensory_details_used.sound: a comm voice answering before it is asked
